name: Lazotep
description: A rare magical metallic-blue mineral, strong yet light, used for cartouches, tomb seals and the armor of the Eternals.

description_citations.text: "Lazotep Mines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazotep is secretly hidden aboard funerary barges and delivered to the necropolis to coat the bodies of the chosen dead, forging the Eternals.
timeline.quote: forging an army in waiting for the prophesied return of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Lazotep Mines", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A mystical blue mineral mined under the God-Pharaoh's command and used to coat the worthy dead.
